title: Phantasmal Gardener
move_pattern: Move depends on starting slot position. Cycles: Bite → Lash → Flail → Enlarge → (repeat). Note: Lash move is not shown in bestiary display.
notes: Phantasmal Gardener scales up with each Enlarge move used, with scale increasing logarithmically based on the number of times Enlarge has been triggered. Starting move depends on its slot position: first slot starts with Flail, second with Bite, third with Lash, fourth with Enlarge.
